SELECT answer_id, article_id, answerer_id, answerer_type, answerer_name, answerer_dept, content, file_group_id, is_final, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at FROM tb_complaint_answer WHERE answer_id = #{answerId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
